methods: Direct argument-array invocation of packaged mkvmerge/mkvextract 102.0; their SHA256 values were matched to the pre-GUI pinned-binary provenance.

Identification JSON format 20; exact retained UID count/order and independent source-local to output-local ID mapping; kind, codec, title, raw languages, effective default/forced/enabled flags and remaining known track properties compared.
Only raw UID (checked separately), track number and index-entry count (layout), and minimum_timestamp (all timestamps checked separately) excluded from the raw-property comparison.

All five complete extracted representations hashed against pre-GUI oracles: two VP8 IVF files, two PCM WAV files and one UTF-8 SRT file; extraction format follows codec rather than the .payload extension.
Every native timestamp and final synthetic boundary compared with equal line counts and at most 1 ms permitted delta; the observed maximum was 0 ms for all five tracks.

Bounded chapter/tag XML with external DTD/entity resolution disabled; ordinary semantic structure compared, chapter sequence retained and removed-track tags excluded from expectations; container title compared.
Attachment metadata compared; source/output attachment bytes independently extracted to owned names and SHA256 compared.
Both original source SHA256 values compared with frozen pre-GUI values and rechecked after verification; folder-discovery copies/nested source and existing collision sentinel also checked unchanged.
Read-only scan for .tracktrim-* candidates and portable data/ownership and data/inspection contents; main output directory required to contain exactly the two expected final files.

Fail-closed Windows CIM snapshots of mkvmerge/mkvextract by executable path or owned-kit command line before/after verification; query errors or unidentified native processes reject the zero-worker claim.
limitations: This receipt covers these two frozen synthetic VP8/PCM/SRT fixtures only; it is not a general container/codec preservation guarantee.

Payload equality concerns codec-specific extracted IVF/WAV and reconstructed SRT representations; SRT equality is not raw Matroska packet-byte equality, and whole-container source/output equality is not expected.
Ordinary fixture XML is compared strictly; this helper does not implement the production AAC, MakeMKV UID-remapping or general language-equivalence policies.
Source hashes establish unchanged observed file contents; they do not audit OS write-handle access or detect a modification that was fully reverted between observations.
Cleanup and worker absence are point-in-time observations, not independent proof of native cancellation, warning handling, close/restart recovery or generic descendant containment.
Unchanged discovery files and collision sentinel do not prove that supplemental folder/collision GUI actions were exercised; those require separate owner-observed GUI evidence.
The observed native environment was Windows 10 build 19045.6456; this receipt does not establish Windows 11 or Ubuntu desktop acceptance.
